messages:
Emma Chen: Hi hi! I'm Emma — starting on UI today 🎉 Quick q: what's the recommended laptop choice here (Mac M2 vs Linux devbox)? Also I haven't grabbed my office badge yet — who should I ping for that? And how do I get SSH access to the repos?

Jae Park: Welcome Emma!! For frontend folks we usually provision Mac M2s by default. If you have strong Linux needs (tooling/debugging) we can request a Linux devbox instead. I'll DM you the provisioning form. @Morgan (IT) can help with badge & MDM setup. :raised_hands:

Morgan (IT): Hey Emma — welcome 🎉 Send your preferred shipping address in a DM. For the badge, please fill out this quick form: https://redwood.intranet/forms/badge and we'll schedule a pickup at HQ reception. To enroll in MDM on Mac run:

```
# open company MDM installer
open /Applications/CompanyMDM/Enroll.app
```

Then paste the device asset tag into the form. If you run into a permission popup, ping me here and I can guide you.

Lena Morales: HR update: payroll + benefits emails have been sent to your personal email on file. Check the onboarding checklist in Notion for the remaining items. Also assigned a buddy for your first week: @Rajiv Patel.

Rajiv Patel: Hey Emma — hi! I'll be your buddy this week. For SSH access to our GitHub org: generate a key and add the public key to the internal key manager. Quick steps:

1) `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "emma@redwood.com"`
2) `pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` (Mac) or cat on Linux
3) paste at https://redwood.github.io/ssh-keys and request repo access in the UI

If you want, we can do a short pairing session at 3pm PST to get you into the repos and the local dev flow. :coffee:

Emma Chen: Perfect — thanks everyone! I'll DM shipping address and the form link now. One more silly thing: stickers for laptop? I'm super into cats and plants, allergic to avocado jokes 😅

Jae Park: Sticker bin at the office has both cats and plants — should be good. Also I'll invite you to the main channels: #eng-ui, #design-feedback, #devex. Sending invites now.

BuddyBot: Emma Chen was added to #eng-ui and #devex. :tada:
